import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'dart:convert';
import '../models/reel.dart';
import '../services/reel_service.dart';
import '../utils/constants.dart';
import 'package:share_plus/share_plus.dart';
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:webview_flutter/webview_flutter.dart';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';

class ShareReelPage extends StatefulWidget {
  final String token;
  final String? initialUrl;

  const ShareReelPage({
    Key? key,
    required this.token,
    this.initialUrl,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  _ShareReelPageState createState() => _ShareReelPageState();
}

class _ShareReelPageState extends State<ShareReelPage> {
  final _urlController = TextEditingController();
  final _tagController = TextEditingController();
  late ReelService _reelService;
  List<Category> _categories = [];
  List<String> _selectedTags = [];
  Category? _selectedCategory;
  bool _isLoading = false;
  Map<String, dynamic>? _reelInfo;
  bool _isInitialized = false;
  bool _isServiceReady = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _urlController.addListener(_onUrlChanged);
    _initializeService();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    _processInitialUrl();
  }

  Future<void> _processInitialUrl() async {
    if (!_isInitialized && widget.initialUrl != null) {
      _isInitialized = true;
      print('Processing initial URL: ${widget.initialUrl}');
      
      // Wait for service to be ready
      if (!_isServiceReady) {
        print('Waiting for service to be ready...');
        await Future.doWhile(() async {
          await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 100));
          return !_isServiceReady;
        });
      }
      
      setState(() {
        _urlController.text = widget.initialUrl!;
      });
      
      // Small delay to ensure URL is set
      await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 100));
      await _extractReelInfo();
    }
  }

  void _onUrlChanged() {
    if (_urlController.text.isNotEmpty && _isServiceReady) {
      print('URL changed: ${_urlController.text}');
      _extractReelInfo();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _initializeService() async {
    try {
      print('Initializing service...');
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      _reelService = ReelService(token: widget.token, prefs: prefs);
      await _loadCategories();
      setState(() {
        _isServiceReady = true;
      });
      print('Service initialized successfully');
    } catch (e) {
      print('Error initializing service: $e');
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Failed to initialize: $e'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.red,
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _loadCategories() async {
    try {
      print('Loading categories...');
      final response = await http.get(
        Uri.parse('${ApiConstants.baseUrl}/api/categories'),
        headers: {
          'Authorization': 'Bearer ${widget.token}',
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
      );

      print('Categories response status: ${response.statusCode}');
      print('Categories response body: ${response.body}');

      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        final List<dynamic> categoriesJson = json.decode(response.body);
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            _categories = categoriesJson
                .map((json) => Category.fromJson(json))
                .toList();
          });
        }
        print('Successfully loaded ${_categories.length} categories');
      } else {
        print('Failed to load categories: ${response.statusCode}');
        if (mounted) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            const SnackBar(
              content: Text('Failed to load categories. Please try again later.'),
              backgroundColor: Colors.orange,
            ),
          );
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      print('Error loading categories: $e');
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Error loading categories: $e'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.red,
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _extractReelInfo() async {
    if (!_isServiceReady) {
      print('Service not ready yet, cannot extract reel info');
      return;
    }

    if (_urlController.text.isEmpty) {
      print('_extractReelInfo called with empty URL');
      setState(() {
        _reelInfo = null;
        _isLoading = false;
      });
      return;
    }

    print('Starting to extract info from URL: ${_urlController.text}');
    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
      _reelInfo = null;
    });

    try {
      final info = await _reelService.extractReelInfo(_urlController.text);
      print('Extracted info result: $info');
      
      if (info == null) {
        if (mounted) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            const SnackBar(
              content: Text('Could not extract information from this URL. Please make sure it\'s a valid social media URL.'),
              backgroundColor: Colors.orange,
              duration: Duration(seconds: 4),
            ),
          );
        }
        setState(() {
          _isLoading = false;
        });
        return;
      }

      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _reelInfo = info;
          _isLoading = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      print('Error in _extractReelInfo: $e');
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _isLoading = false;
        });
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Error processing URL: ${e.toString()}'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.red,
            duration: const Duration(seconds: 4),
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  void _handleSharedText(String sharedText) {
    if (mounted && _isServiceReady) {
      setState(() {
        _urlController.text = sharedText;
      });
    }
  }

  void _addTag(String tag) {
    if (tag.isNotEmpty && !_selectedTags.contains(tag)) {
      setState(() {
        _selectedTags.add(tag);
        _tagController.clear();
      });
    }
  }

  void _removeTag(String tag) {
    setState(() {
      _selectedTags.remove(tag);
    });
  }

  Future<void> _saveReel() async {
    if (_reelInfo == null) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Please enter a valid URL and wait for it to be processed'),
          backgroundColor: Colors.orange,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
    });

    try {
      final savedReel = await _reelService.saveReel(
        platform: _reelInfo!['platform'],
        reelId: _reelInfo!['reel_id'],
        url: _reelInfo!['url'],
        thumbnailUrl: _reelInfo!['thumbnail_url'],
        caption: _reelInfo!['caption'],
        author: _reelInfo!['author'],
        categoryId: _selectedCategory?.id,
        tags: _selectedTags,
        metadata: _reelInfo!['metadata'],
      );

      setState(() {
        _isLoading = false;
      });

      if (mounted) {
        if (savedReel != null) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            const SnackBar(
              content: Text('Reel saved successfully!'),
              backgroundColor: Colors.green,
            ),
          );
          Navigator.pop(context);
        } else {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            const SnackBar(
              content: Text('Reel will be saved when you\'re back online'),
              backgroundColor: Colors.orange,
            ),
          );
          Navigator.pop(context);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      print('Error saving reel: $e');
      setState(() {
        _isLoading = false;
      });
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Error saving reel: ${e.toString()}'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.red,
            duration: const Duration(seconds: 4),
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _urlController.removeListener(_onUrlChanged);
    _urlController.dispose();
    _tagController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('Share Reel'),
      ),
      body: _isServiceReady ? SingleChildScrollView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            TextField(
              controller: _urlController,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                labelText: 'Reel URL',
                hintText: 'Paste Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube URL',
                border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
                suffixIcon: Row(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    if (_urlController.text.isNotEmpty)
                      IconButton(
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.clear),
                        onPressed: () {
                          setState(() {
                            _urlController.clear();
                            _reelInfo = null;
                          });
                        },
                      ),
                    IconButton(
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.paste),
                      onPressed: () async {
                        final data = await Clipboard.getData('text/plain');
                        if (data?.text != null) {
                          setState(() {
                            _urlController.text = data!.text!;
                          });
                          _extractReelInfo();
                        }
                      },
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              onChanged: (_) => _extractReelInfo(),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            
            _buildCategoryDropdown(),
            
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            
            // Tags Input
            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: TextField(
                    controller: _tagController,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'Add Tags',
                      hintText: 'Enter a tag and press add',
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                    ),
                    onSubmitted: _addTag,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                ElevatedButton(
                  onPressed: () => _addTag(_tagController.text),
                  child: const Text('Add Tag'),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            
            // Selected Tags
            Wrap(
              spacing: 8,
              children: _selectedTags.map((tag) {
                return Chip(
                  label: Text(tag),
                  onDeleted: () => _removeTag(tag),
                );
              }).toList(),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),

            if (_isLoading)
              const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
            else if (_reelInfo != null) ...[
              Card(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8.0),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      AspectRatio(
                        aspectRatio: 16 / 9,
                        child: _buildThumbnailPreview(),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      Text(
                        _reelInfo!['caption'] ?? 'No caption',
                        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 4),
                      Text(
                        _reelInfo!['author'] ?? 'Unknown author',
                        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium,
                      ),
                      if (_reelInfo!['metadata']?['thumbnail_urls'] != null) ...[
                        const SizedBox(height: 8),
                        const Text(
                          'Available Thumbnails:',
                          style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 4),
                        SingleChildScrollView(
                          scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                          child: Row(
                            children: (_reelInfo!['metadata']['thumbnail_urls'] as List)
                                .map((url) => Padding(
                                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8.0),
                                      child: GestureDetector(
                                        onTap: () {
                                          setState(() {
                                            _reelInfo!['thumbnail_url'] = url;
                                          });
                                        },
                                        child: Container(
                                          width: 80,
                                          height: 80,
                                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                            border: Border.all(
                                              color: _reelInfo!['thumbnail_url'] == url
                                                  ? Theme.of(context).primaryColor
                                                  : Colors.grey,
                                              width: _reelInfo!['thumbnail_url'] == url ? 2 : 1,
                                            ),
                                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                                          ),
                                          child: ClipRRect(
                                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                                            child: Image.network(
                                              url,
                                              fit: BoxFit.cover,
                                              errorBuilder: (context, error, stackTrace) {
                                                return Container(
                                                  color: Colors.grey[200],
                                                  child: const Icon(
                                                    Icons.error_outline,
                                                    color: Colors.red,
                                                  ),
                                                );
                                              },
                                            ),
                                          ),
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ))
                                .toList(),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
            const SizedBox(height: 24),
            
            // Save Button
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: _isLoading ? null : _saveReel,
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
              ),
              child: _isLoading
                  ? const SizedBox(
                      height: 20,
                      width: 20,
                      child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                        strokeWidth: 2,
                        valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(Colors.white),
                      ),
                    )
                  : const Text('Save Reel'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ) : const Center(
        child: CircularProgressIndicator(),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildCategoryDropdown() {
    return DropdownButtonFormField<Category>(
      value: _selectedCategory,
      isExpanded: true,
      decoration: const InputDecoration(
        labelText: 'Category',
        border: OutlineInputBorder(),
      ),
      items: _categories.isEmpty
          ? [
              const DropdownMenuItem(
                value: null,
                child: Text(
                  'No categories available - Add one in settings',
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                ),
              ),
            ]
          : _categories.map((Category category) {
              return DropdownMenuItem(
                value: category,
                child: Text(
                  category.name,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                ),
              );
            }).toList(),
      onChanged: _categories.isEmpty ? null : (Category? newValue) {
        setState(() {
          _selectedCategory = newValue;
        });
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildThumbnailPreview() {
    if (_reelInfo!['platform'] == 'facebook') {
      // Create a temporary Reel object for the preview
      final previewReel = Reel(
        id: 0,
        platform: 'facebook',
        reelId: _reelInfo!['reel_id'],
        url: _reelInfo!['url'],
        thumbnailUrl: _reelInfo!['thumbnail_url'],
        caption: _reelInfo!['caption'],
        author: _reelInfo!['author'],
        createdAt: DateTime.now(),
        metadata: {
          'final_video_id': _reelInfo!['metadata']['final_video_id'],
          'video_id': _reelInfo!['metadata']['video_id'],
          'embed_url': _reelInfo!['metadata']['embed_url'],
        },
        isSynced: true,
        tags: [], // Add empty tags list
      );
      
      return _FacebookVideoPreview(
        reel: previewReel,
        onTap: () => _launchURL(_reelInfo!['url']),
      );
    }

    // For other platforms, use the existing image preview
    return FutureBuilder<bool>(
      future: _checkThumbnailUrl(_reelInfo!['thumbnail_url']),
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        if (snapshot.hasData && snapshot.data == true) {
          return Image.network(
            _reelInfo!['thumbnail_url'],
            fit: BoxFit.cover,
            errorBuilder: (context, error, stackTrace) {
              print('Error loading primary thumbnail: $error');
              return _buildFallbackThumbnail();
            },
          );
        } else {
          return _buildFallbackThumbnail();
        }
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildFallbackThumbnail() {
    if (_reelInfo!['metadata']?['thumbnail_urls'] != null &&
        (_reelInfo!['metadata']['thumbnail_urls'] as List).isNotEmpty) {
      // Try each alternative thumbnail URL until one works
      return _buildThumbnailGrid();
    }
    return Container(
      color: Colors.grey[300],
      child: Column(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
        children: [
          Icon(
            Icons.error_outline,
            color: Colors.red,
            size: 36,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text(
            'Failed to load thumbnail',
            style: TextStyle(
              color: Colors.grey[600],
              fontSize: 14,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildThumbnailGrid() {
    final thumbnailUrls = _reelInfo!['metadata']['thumbnail_urls'] as List;
    return GridView.builder(
      shrinkWrap: true,
      physics: NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
      gridDelegate: SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
        crossAxisCount: 2,
        childAspectRatio: 1,
        crossAxisSpacing: 8,
        mainAxisSpacing: 8,
      ),
      itemCount: thumbnailUrls.length,
      itemBuilder: (context, index) {
        return GestureDetector(
          onTap: () {
            setState(() {
              _reelInfo!['thumbnail_url'] = thumbnailUrls[index];
            });
          },
          child: Container(
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              border: Border.all(
                color: _reelInfo!['thumbnail_url'] == thumbnailUrls[index]
                    ? Theme.of(context).primaryColor
                    : Colors.grey,
                width: _reelInfo!['thumbnail_url'] == thumbnailUrls[index] ? 2 : 1,
              ),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
            ),
            child: ClipRRect(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
              child: Image.network(
                thumbnailUrls[index],
                fit: BoxFit.cover,
                errorBuilder: (context, error, stackTrace) {
                  return Container(
                    color: Colors.grey[200],
                    child: Icon(
                      Icons.error_outline,
                      color: Colors.red,
                    ),
                  );
                },
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Future<bool> _checkThumbnailUrl(String url) async {
    try {
      final response = await http.head(Uri.parse(url));
      return response.statusCode == 200;
    } catch (e) {
      print('Error checking thumbnail URL: $e');
      return false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _launchURL(String url) async {
    try {
      print('Attempting to launch URL: $url');
      
      // For Facebook URLs
      if (url.contains('facebook.com') || url.contains('fb.watch')) {
        String? videoId;
        
        // First check if we have the final video ID in metadata
        if (_reelInfo != null && _reelInfo!['platform'] == 'facebook') {
          videoId = _reelInfo!['metadata']['final_video_id'];
          if (videoId != null) {
            print('Using final video ID from metadata: $videoId');
          } else {
            videoId = _reelInfo!['metadata']['video_id'];
            print('Using regular video ID from metadata: $videoId');
          }
        }
        
        // If no video ID in metadata, try to extract from URL
        if (videoId == null) {
          final patterns = [
            r'videos/(\d+)',
            r'watch\?v=(\d+)',
            r'watch/\?v=(\d+)',
            r'reel/(\d+)',
            r'share/r/([^/?]+)',
            r'share/v/([^/?]+)',
          ];
          
          for (final pattern in patterns) {
            final match = RegExp(pattern).firstMatch(url);
            if (match != null) {
              videoId = match.group(1);
              print('Extracted video ID from URL: $videoId');
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (videoId != null) {
          // Try Facebook deep links in order
          final deepLinks = [
            'fb://reel/$videoId',
            'fb://video/$videoId',
            'fb://watch/$videoId',
          ];

          for (final deepLink in deepLinks) {
            print('Trying Facebook deep link: $deepLink');
            if (await canLaunchUrl(Uri.parse(deepLink))) {
              await launchUrl(Uri.parse(deepLink), mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
              return;
            }
          }
        }
      }
      
      // For Instagram URLs
      else if (url.contains('instagram.com')) {
        String? mediaId;
        
        // Extract media ID from URL
        if (url.contains('/reel/')) {
          mediaId = url.split('/reel/')[1].split('/')[0].split('?')[0];
        } else if (url.contains('/p/')) {
          mediaId = url.split('/p/')[1].split('/')[0].split('?')[0];
        }
        
        if (mediaId != null) {
          // Try Instagram deep links in order
          final deepLinks = [
            'instagram://reels/$mediaId',
            'instagram://media?id=$mediaId',
          ];

          for (final deepLink in deepLinks) {
            print('Trying Instagram deep link: $deepLink');
            if (await canLaunchUrl(Uri.parse(deepLink))) {
              await launchUrl(Uri.parse(deepLink), mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
              return;
            }
          }
        }
      }
      
      // For TikTok URLs
      else if (url.contains('tiktok.com')) {
        String? videoId;
        
        // Extract video ID from URL
        if (url.contains('/video/')) {
          videoId = url.split('/video/')[1].split('/')[0].split('?')[0];
        }
        
        if (videoId != null) {
          // Try TikTok deep links in order
          final deepLinks = [
            'snssdk1233://video/detail/$videoId',  // TikTok app
            'tiktok://video/$videoId',             // Alternative format
          ];

          for (final deepLink in deepLinks) {
            print('Trying TikTok deep link: $deepLink');
            if (await canLaunchUrl(Uri.parse(deepLink))) {
              await launchUrl(Uri.parse(deepLink), mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
              return;
            }
          }
        }
      }
      
      // For YouTube URLs
      else if (url.contains('youtube.com') || url.contains('youtu.be')) {
        String? videoId;
        
        // Extract video ID from different YouTube URL formats
        if (url.contains('youtu.be/')) {
          videoId = url.split('youtu.be/')[1].split('?')[0];
        } else if (url.contains('youtube.com/watch')) {
          videoId = url.split('v=')[1].split('&')[0];
        } else if (url.contains('youtube.com/shorts/')) {
          videoId = url.split('shorts/')[1].split('?')[0];
        }
        
        if (videoId != null) {
          // Try YouTube deep links in order
          final deepLinks = [
            'vnd.youtube://$videoId',           // Standard format
            'youtube://www.youtube.com/v/$videoId',  // Alternative format
          ];

          for (final deepLink in deepLinks) {
            print('Trying YouTube deep link: $deepLink');
            if (await canLaunchUrl(Uri.parse(deepLink))) {
              await launchUrl(Uri.parse(deepLink), mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
              return;
            }
          }
        }
      }
      
      // If no deep link worked or platform not recognized, try the original URL
      print('Falling back to original URL: $url');
      final uri = Uri.parse(url);
      if (await canLaunchUrl(uri)) {
        await launchUrl(uri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
      } else {
        print('Could not launch $url');
        throw 'Could not launch $url';
      }
    } catch (e) {
      print('Error launching URL: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }
}

// Add the Facebook video preview widget
class _FacebookVideoPreview extends StatefulWidget {
  final Reel reel;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  const _FacebookVideoPreview({
    Key? key,
    required this.reel,
    required this.onTap,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<_FacebookVideoPreview> createState() => _FacebookVideoPreviewState();
}

class _FacebookVideoPreviewState extends State<_FacebookVideoPreview> {
  late final WebViewController controller;
  bool isLoading = true;
  bool hasError = false;
  String? errorMessage;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _initializeController();
  }

  void _initializeController() {
    try {
      print('Initializing Facebook video preview with reel: ${widget.reel.toJson()}');
      
      // Get the final video ID from metadata if available, otherwise fallback to video_id or reel_id
      final videoId = widget.reel.metadata['final_video_id'] ?? widget.reel.metadata['video_id'] ?? widget.reel.reelId;
      print('Using video ID: $videoId');
      
      String embedUrl;
      if (videoId != null && videoId.isNotEmpty) {
        // Use watch format URL for better compatibility
        final watchUrl = 'https://www.facebook.com/watch/?v=$videoId';
        final encodedWatchUrl = Uri.encodeComponent(watchUrl);
        embedUrl = 'https://www.facebook.com/plugins/video.php?href=$encodedWatchUrl&show_text=false&width=560&height=315&appId=550689493956425';
      } else {
        // Fallback to using the original URL
        final encodedUrl = Uri.encodeComponent(widget.reel.url);
        embedUrl = 'https://www.facebook.com/plugins/video.php?href=$encodedUrl&show_text=false&width=560&height=315&appId=550689493956425';
      }
      
      print('Using embed URL: $embedUrl');
      
      controller = WebViewController()
        ..setJavaScriptMode(JavaScriptMode.unrestricted)
        ..setBackgroundColor(Colors.grey[300]!)
        ..setNavigationDelegate(
          NavigationDelegate(
            onPageStarted: (String url) {
              print('WebView started loading: $url');
              if (mounted) {
                setState(() {
                  isLoading = true;
                  hasError = false;
                  errorMessage = null;
                });
              }
            },
            onPageFinished: (String url) {
              print('WebView finished loading: $url');
              if (mounted) {
                setState(() {
                  isLoading = false;
                });
              }
            },
            onWebResourceError: (WebResourceError error) {
              print('WebView error loading video ID $videoId:');
              print('Error code: ${error.errorCode}');
              print('Error type: ${error.errorType}');
              print('Error description: ${error.description}');
              print('Failed URL: ${error.url}');
              
              if (mounted) {
                setState(() {
                  hasError = true;
                  isLoading = false;
                  errorMessage = 'Error loading video preview (${error.errorCode})';
                });
              }
            },
          ),
        )
        ..setUserAgent('Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/121.0.0.0 Safari/537.36')
        ..loadRequest(Uri.parse(embedUrl));
    } catch (e, stackTrace) {
      print('Error initializing WebView controller: $e');
      print('Stack trace: $stackTrace');
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          hasError = true;
          isLoading = false;
          errorMessage = 'Failed to initialize video preview';
        });
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: widget.onTap,
      child: Container(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.grey[300],
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
        ),
        child: Stack(
          fit: StackFit.expand,
          children: [
            if (!hasError) ...[
              ClipRRect(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                child: WebViewWidget(controller: controller),
              ),
            ],
            if (isLoading || hasError)
              Container(
                color: Colors.grey[300],
                child: Center(
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      if (isLoading && !hasError)
                        CircularProgressIndicator(color: Colors.grey[600])
                      else if (hasError)
                        Icon(Icons.error_outline, size: 40, color: Colors.grey[600]),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      Text(
                        hasError 
                          ? 'Failed to load preview\n${errorMessage ?? ''}'
                          : 'Loading preview...',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          color: Colors.grey[600],
                          fontSize: 14,
                        ),
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            // Overlay gradient
            Positioned.fill(
              child: Container(
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  gradient: LinearGradient(
                    begin: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                    end: Alignment.topCenter,
                    colors: [
                      Colors.black.withOpacity(0.8),
                      Colors.transparent,
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            // Play button overlay
            if (!isLoading && !hasError)
              Center(
                child: Container(
                  width: 60,
                  height: 60,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.7),
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  ),
                  child: const Icon(
                    Icons.play_arrow,
                    color: Colors.white,
                    size: 40,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            // Facebook branding
            Positioned(
              bottom: 0,
              left: 0,
              right: 0,
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12, horizontal: 16),
                child: Row(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    const Icon(Icons.facebook, color: Colors.white, size: 20),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Text(
                        'Watch on Facebook',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          color: Colors.white,
                          fontSize: 14,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

================
File: lib/services/auth_service.dart
================
import 'package:flutter_secure_storage/flutter_secure_storage.dart';
import 'package:local_auth/local_auth.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'dart:convert';
import '../utils/constants.dart';

class AuthService {
  static const _storage = FlutterSecureStorage();
  static const _tokenKey = 'auth_token';
  static const _emailKey = 'user_email';
  static const _rememberMeKey = 'remember_me';
  static const _biometricEnabledKey = 'biometric_enabled';
  static const _tokenExpiryKey = 'token_expiry';
  
  static final LocalAuthentication _localAuth = LocalAuthentication();

  // Check if user is logged in and token is valid
  static Future<bool> isLoggedIn() async {
    final token = await getToken();
    final email = await getEmail();
    if (token == null || email == null) {
      return false;
    }

    // Check token expiry
    final expiryStr = await _storage.read(key: _tokenExpiryKey);
    if (expiryStr != null) {
      final expiry = DateTime.parse(expiryStr);
      if (expiry.isBefore(DateTime.now())) {
        // Token has expired, try to refresh
        final refreshed = await _refreshToken(token);
        return refreshed;
      }
    }

    return true;
  }

  // Token refresh logic
  static Future<bool> _refreshToken(String currentToken) async {
    try {
      final response = await http.post(
        Uri.parse('${ApiConstants.baseUrl}/api/refresh-token'),
        headers: {
          'Authorization': 'Bearer $currentToken',
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
      );

      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        final data = json.decode(response.body);
        final newToken = data['access_token'];
        await saveToken(newToken);
        
        // Set token expiry to 29 days from now (1 day before actual expiry)
        final expiry = DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 29));
        await _storage.write(key: _tokenExpiryKey, value: expiry.toIso8601String());
        
        return true;
      }
      
      // If refresh failed, clear the token
      await logout();
      return false;
    } catch (e) {
      print('Error refreshing token: $e');
      await logout();
      return false;
    }
  }

  // Get stored credentials
  static Future<Map<String, String?>> getStoredCredentials() async {
    final token = await getToken();
    final email = await getEmail();
    
    // Validate token if exists
    if (token != null) {
      final isValid = await isLoggedIn();
      if (!isValid) {
        return {
          'token': null,
          'email': email,
        };
      }
    }
    
    return {
      'token': token,
      'email': email,
    };
  }

  // Token management
  static Future<void> saveToken(String token) async {
    await _storage.write(key: _tokenKey, value: token);
    
    // Set token expiry to 29 days from now (1 day before actual expiry)
    final expiry = DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 29));
    await _storage.write(key: _tokenExpiryKey, value: expiry.toIso8601String());
  }

  static Future<String?> getToken() async {
    return await _storage.read(key: _tokenKey);
  }

  static Future<void> deleteToken() async {
    await _storage.delete(key: _tokenKey);
  }

  // User email management
  static Future<void> saveEmail(String email) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(_emailKey, email);
  }

  static Future<String?> getEmail() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    return prefs.getString(_emailKey);
  }

  // Remember me functionality
  static Future<void> setRememberMe(bool value) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setBool(_rememberMeKey, value);
  }

  static Future<bool> getRememberMe() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    return prefs.getBool(_rememberMeKey) ?? false;
  }

  // Biometric authentication
  static Future<void> setBiometricEnabled(bool value) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setBool(_biometricEnabledKey, value);
  }

  static Future<bool> getBiometricEnabled() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    return prefs.getBool(_biometricEnabledKey) ?? false;
  }

  static Future<bool> isBiometricAvailable() async {
    try {
      return await _localAuth.canCheckBiometrics;
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  static Future<bool> authenticateWithBiometrics() async {
    try {
      return await _localAuth.authenticate(
        localizedReason: 'Please authenticate to access the app',
        options: const AuthenticationOptions(
          stickyAuth: true,
          biometricOnly: true,
        ),
      );
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  // Enhanced logout
  static Future<void> logout() async {
    await Future.wait([
      deleteToken(),
      _storage.delete(key: _tokenExpiryKey),
      getRememberMe().then((rememberMe) async {
        if (!rememberMe) {
          final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
          await prefs.remove(_emailKey);
        }
      }),
    ]);
  }
}

================
File: lib/services/reel_service.dart
================
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import '../models/reel.dart';
import '../utils/constants.dart';
import 'package:connectivity_plus/connectivity_plus.dart';

class ReelService {
  final String token;
  final SharedPreferences _prefs;
  final http.Client _client;
  static const String _offlineReelsKey = 'offline_reels';
  static const String _pendingUploadsKey = 'pending_uploads';

  ReelService({
    required this.token,
    required SharedPreferences prefs,
    http.Client? client,
  }) : _prefs = prefs,
       _client = client ?? http.Client();

  Map<String, String> get _headers => {
    'Authorization': 'Bearer $token',
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'Accept': 'application/json',
  };

  // Fetch reels with filtering and search
  Future<List<Reel>> getReels({
    int skip = 0,
    int limit = 20,
    String? search,
    int? categoryId,
    String? tag,
    String? platform,
  }) async {
    try {
      final connectivityResult = await Connectivity().checkConnectivity();
      print('Connectivity result: $connectivityResult');
      
      if (connectivityResult == ConnectivityResult.none) {
        print('No internet connection, loading offline reels');
        return _getOfflineReels();
      }

      final queryParams = {
        'skip': skip.toString(),
        'limit': limit.toString(),
        if (search != null) 'search': search,
        if (categoryId != null) 'category_id': categoryId.toString(),
        if (tag != null) 'tag': tag,
        if (platform != null) 'platform': platform,
      };

      final url = Uri.parse('${ApiConstants.baseUrl}/api/reels')
          .replace(queryParameters: queryParams);
      print('Fetching reels from: $url');
      print('Using headers: $_headers');
      print('Token being used: $token');

      try {
        final response = await _client.get(url, headers: _headers);
        print('Response status code: ${response.statusCode}');
        print('Response headers: ${response.headers}');
        print('Response body: ${response.body}');

        if (response.statusCode == 200) {
          final List<dynamic> reelsJson = json.decode(response.body);
          final reels = reelsJson.map((json) => Reel.fromJson(json)).toList();
          print('Loaded ${reels.length} reels');
          await _saveReelsOffline(reels);
          return reels;
        } else if (response.statusCode == 401) {
          print('Authentication failed - invalid or expired token');
          throw Exception('Authentication failed: Please log in again');
        } else {
          final error = json.decode(response.body)['detail'] ?? 'Unknown error';
          print('API error: $error');
          throw Exception('Failed to load reels: $error');
        }
      } on http.ClientException catch (e) {
        print('HTTP client exception: $e');
        throw Exception('Network error: Unable to connect to server');
      } on FormatException catch (e) {
        print('Format exception: $e');
        throw Exception('Data format error: Invalid response from server');
      } catch (e) {
        print('Unexpected error during HTTP request: $e');
        rethrow;
      }
    } catch (e, stackTrace) {
      print('Error loading reels: $e');
      print('Stack trace: $stackTrace');
      
      if (e is Exception && (e.toString().contains('Authentication failed') || 
          e.toString().contains('Failed to load reels'))) {
        rethrow;
      }
      return _getOfflineReels();
    }
  }

  // Save reels for offline access
  Future<void> _saveReelsOffline(List<Reel> reels) async {
    final reelsJson = reels.map((reel) => reel.toJson()).toList();
    await _prefs.setString(_offlineReelsKey, json.encode(reelsJson));
  }

  // Get reels from offline storage
  Future<List<Reel>> _getOfflineReels() async {
    final reelsJson = _prefs.getString(_offlineReelsKey);
    if (reelsJson == null) return [];

    final List<dynamic> decodedReels = json.decode(reelsJson);
    return decodedReels.map((json) => Reel.fromJson(json)).toList();
  }

  // Save a reel with offline support
  Future<Reel?> saveReel({
    required String platform,
    required String reelId,
    required String url,
    required String thumbnailUrl,
    required String caption,
    required String author,
    int? categoryId,
    List<String> tags = const [],
    Map<String, dynamic> metadata = const {},
  }) async {
    final reelData = {
      'platform': platform,
      'reel_id': reelId,
      'url': url,
      'thumbnail_url': thumbnailUrl,
      'caption': caption,
      'author': author,
      if (categoryId != null) 'category_id': categoryId,
      'tags': tags,
      'reel_metadata': metadata,  // Changed from metadata to reel_metadata to match API
    };

    print('Attempting to save reel: $reelData');

    try {
      final connectivityResult = await Connectivity().checkConnectivity();
      if (connectivityResult == ConnectivityResult.none) {
        print('No internet connection, saving reel for later upload');
        await _savePendingUpload(reelData);
        return null;
      }

      final response = await _client.post(
        Uri.parse('${ApiConstants.baseUrl}/api/reels'),
        headers: {
          'Authorization': 'Bearer $token',
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: json.encode(reelData),
      );

      print('Save reel response status: ${response.statusCode}');
      print('Save reel response body: ${response.body}');

      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        final savedReel = Reel.fromJson(json.decode(response.body));
        print('Reel saved successfully with ID: ${savedReel.id}');
        return savedReel;
      } else {
        final error = json.decode(response.body)['detail'] ?? 'Unknown error';
        print('Failed to save reel: $error');
        await _savePendingUpload(reelData);
        throw Exception('Failed to save reel: $error');
      }
    } catch (e, stackTrace) {
      print('Error saving reel: $e');
      print('Stack trace: $stackTrace');
      await _savePendingUpload(reelData);
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  // Save pending upload for offline mode
  Future<void> _savePendingUpload(Map<String, dynamic> reelData) async {
    final pendingUploads = await _getPendingUploads();
    pendingUploads.add(reelData);
    await _prefs.setString(_pendingUploadsKey, json.encode(pendingUploads));
  }

  // Get pending uploads
  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> _getPendingUploads() async {
    final uploadsJson = _prefs.getString(_pendingUploadsKey);
    if (uploadsJson == null) return [];

    final List<dynamic> decoded = json.decode(uploadsJson);
    return decoded.cast<Map<String, dynamic>>();
  }

  // Sync pending uploads when online
  Future<void> syncPendingUploads() async {
    final connectivityResult = await Connectivity().checkConnectivity();
    if (connectivityResult == ConnectivityResult.none) return;

    final pendingUploads = await _getPendingUploads();
    if (pendingUploads.isEmpty) return;

    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> failedUploads = [];

    for (final reelData in pendingUploads) {
      try {
        final response = await _client.post(
          Uri.parse('${ApiConstants.baseUrl}/api/reels'),
          headers: {
            'Authorization': 'Bearer $token',
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          },
          body: json.encode(reelData),
        );

        if (response.statusCode != 200) {
          failedUploads.add(reelData);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        failedUploads.add(reelData);
      }
    }

    await _prefs.setString(_pendingUploadsKey, json.encode(failedUploads));
  }

  // Extract reel information from social media URLs
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> extractReelInfo(String url) async {
    if (url.isEmpty) {
      print('extractReelInfo called with empty URL');
      return null;
    }

    try {
      // Clean the URL
      url = url.trim();
      print('Starting to extract info from URL: $url');

      final response = await _client.post(
        Uri.parse('${ApiConstants.baseUrl}/api/extract-reel-info'),
        headers: {
          'Authorization': 'Bearer $token',
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: json.encode({'url': url}),
      );

      print('Extract info response status: ${response.statusCode}');
      print('Extract info response body: ${response.body}');

      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        final result = json.decode(response.body);
        print('Extracted info result: $result');
        return result;
      } else {
        final error = json.decode(response.body)['detail'] ?? 'Unknown error';
        print('Failed to extract info: $error');
        return null;
      }
    } catch (e, stackTrace) {
      print('Error in extractReelInfo: $e');
      print('Stack trace: $stackTrace');
      return null;
    }
  }

  // Helper method to decode Unicode escape sequences and HTML entities
  String _decodeString(String input) {
    if (input.isEmpty) {
      return 'Facebook Video';
    }

    // First pass: Decode HTML entities
    var decoded = input
      .replaceAllMapped(RegExp(r'&#x([0-9A-Fa-f]+);'), (match) {
        try {
          final codePoint = int.parse(match.group(1)!, radix: 16);
          return String.fromCharCode(codePoint);
        } catch (e) {
          print('Error decoding hex entity: ${match.group(0)}');
          return '';
        }
      })
      .replaceAllMapped(RegExp(r'&#(\d+);'), (match) {
        try {
          final codePoint = int.parse(match.group(1)!);
          return String.fromCharCode(codePoint);
        } catch (e) {
          print('Error decoding decimal entity: ${match.group(0)}');
          return '';
        }
      });

    // Second pass: Common HTML entities
    decoded = decoded
      .replaceAll('&amp;', '&')
      .replaceAll('&lt;', '<')
      .replaceAll('&gt;', '>')
      .replaceAll('&quot;', '"')
      .replaceAll('&apos;', "'")
      .replaceAll('&nbsp;', ' ');

    // Third pass: Unicode escapes and special characters
    decoded = decoded
      .replaceAll(r'\"', '"')
      .replaceAll(r'\n', '\n')
      .replaceAll(r'\r', '')
      .replaceAll(r'\t', ' ')
      .replaceAll(r'\\', '\\');

    // Fourth pass: Clean up
    decoded = decoded
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ')  // Replace multiple spaces with single space
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'&[^;]+;'), '')  // Remove any remaining HTML entities
      .trim();  // Trim whitespace

    // Return default text if result is empty
    return decoded.trim().isEmpty ? 'Facebook Video' : decoded;
  }
}

class ApiConstants {
  // For Android emulator, use 10.0.2.2 instead of localhost
  // For physical device, use your computer's IP address (e.g., 192.168.1.6)
  // For iOS simulator, use localhost
  static const String baseUrl = 'http://192.168.1.6:8000';
  static const String loginEndpoint = '$baseUrl/api/login';
  static const String registerEndpoint = '$baseUrl/api/register';
}

File: lib/utils/validators.dart

class Validators {
  static String? validateEmail(String? value) {
    if (value == null || value.isEmpty) {
      return 'Email is required';
    }
    
    final emailRegex = RegExp(r'^[\w-\.]+@([\w-]+\.)+[\w-]{2,4}$');
    if (!emailRegex.hasMatch(value)) {
      return 'Please enter a valid email address';
    }
    
    return null;
  }

  static String? validatePassword(String? value) {
    if (value == null || value.isEmpty) {
      return 'Password is required';
    }
    
    if (value.length < 8) {
      return 'Password must be at least 8 characters long';
    }
    
    if (!value.contains(RegExp(r'[A-Z]'))) {
      return 'Password must contain at least one uppercase letter';
    }
    
    if (!value.contains(RegExp(r'[a-z]'))) {
      return 'Password must contain at least one lowercase letter';
    }
    
    if (!value.contains(RegExp(r'[0-9]'))) {
      return 'Password must contain at least one number';
    }
    
    if (!value.contains(RegExp(r'[!@#$%^&*(),.?":{}|<>]'))) {
      return 'Password must contain at least one special character';
    }
    
    return null;
  }

  static String? validateConfirmPassword(String? value, String password) {
    if (value == null || value.isEmpty) {
      return 'Please confirm your password';
    }
    
    if (value != password) {
      return 'Passwords do not match';
    }
    
    return null;
  }

  static String? validateRequired(String? value, String fieldName) {
    if (value == null || value.isEmpty) {
      return '$fieldName is required';
    }
    return null;
  }
}

File: lib/widgets/reel_card.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../models/reel.dart';
import 'package:cached_network_image/cached_network_image.dart';
import 'package:webview_flutter/webview_flutter.dart';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';

class ReelCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final Reel reel;
  final Function(Reel)? onDelete;
  final Function(Reel)? onEdit;

  const ReelCard({
    Key? key,
    required this.reel,
    this.onDelete,
    this.onEdit,
  }) : super(key: key);

  Future<void> _launchURL(BuildContext context, String url) async {
    try {
      print('Attempting to launch URL: $url');
      print('Platform: ${reel.platform}');
      print('Metadata: ${reel.metadata}');

      // Extract video IDs from metadata or URL
      String? finalVideoId = reel.metadata?['finalVideoId'];
      String? regularVideoId = reel.metadata?['regularVideoId'];
      
      if (reel.platform == 'instagram') {
        print('Handling Instagram URL');
        // Try Instagram app URLs first
        final Uri uri = Uri.parse(url);
        final String path = uri.path;
        
        if (path.contains('reel')) {
          final String reelId = path.split('/').where((s) => s.isNotEmpty).last;
          print('Extracted Instagram reel ID: $reelId');
          final instaUrl = Uri.parse('instagram://reels/$reelId');
          print('Trying Instagram app URL: $instaUrl');
          if (await canLaunchUrl(instaUrl)) {
            print('Launching Instagram app URL');
            await launchUrl(
              instaUrl,
              mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication,
            );
            return;
          }
        } else if (path.contains('p')) {
          final String postId = path.split('/').where((s) => s.isNotEmpty).last;
          print('Extracted Instagram post ID: $postId');
          final instaUrl = Uri.parse('instagram://post?id=$postId');
          print('Trying Instagram app URL: $instaUrl');
          if (await canLaunchUrl(instaUrl)) {
            print('Launching Instagram app URL');
            await launchUrl(
              instaUrl,
              mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication,
            );
            return;
          }
        }
        
        // Fallback to web URL
        print('Falling back to Instagram web URL');
        final webUrl = Uri.parse(url);
        if (await canLaunchUrl(webUrl)) {
          await launchUrl(
            webUrl,
            mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication,
          );
          return;
        }
      } else if (reel.platform == 'youtube') {
        print('Handling YouTube URL');
        // Extract video ID from YouTube URL
        String? videoId;
        if (url.contains('youtu.be')) {
          videoId = url.split('/').last.split('?').first;
        } else if (url.contains('youtube.com')) {
          final Uri uri = Uri.parse(url);
          if (url.contains('/shorts/')) {
            videoId = uri.pathSegments.last;
          } else {
            videoId = uri.queryParameters['v'];
          }
        }
        
        print('Extracted YouTube video ID: $videoId');
        
        if (videoId != null) {
          // Try YouTube app URLs first
          final youtubeUrls = [
            Uri.parse('vnd.youtube:$videoId'),
            Uri.parse('youtube://www.youtube.com/watch?v=$videoId'),
            Uri.parse('youtube://youtube.com/watch?v=$videoId'),
          ];
          
          for (final youtubeUrl in youtubeUrls) {
            print('Trying YouTube app URL: $youtubeUrl');
            try {
              if (await canLaunchUrl(youtubeUrl)) {
                print('Launching YouTube app URL: $youtubeUrl');
                await launchUrl(
                  youtubeUrl,
                  mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication,
                );
                return;
              }
            } catch (e) {
              print('Error trying YouTube URL $youtubeUrl: $e');
              continue;
            }
          }
        }
        
        // Fallback to web URL
        print('Falling back to YouTube web URL');
        final webUrl = Uri.parse(url);
        if (await canLaunchUrl(webUrl)) {
          await launchUrl(
            webUrl,
            mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication,
          );
          return;
        }
      } else if (reel.platform == 'facebook') {
        print('Handling Facebook URL');
        print('Original URL: $url');
        
        // Extract video ID using multiple methods
        String? videoId;
        
        // Method 1: Try to extract from metadata
        videoId = finalVideoId ?? regularVideoId ?? reel.metadata['video_id'];
        print('Video ID from metadata: $videoId');
        
        // Method 2: Try to extract from URL if still null
        if (videoId == null) {
          final Uri uri = Uri.parse(url);
          
          // Check query parameters
          videoId = uri.queryParameters['v'];
          print('Video ID from query params: $videoId');
          
          // Check path segments
          if (videoId == null) {
            final pathSegments = uri.pathSegments;
            print('URL path segments: $pathSegments');
            
            // Look for video ID after specific keywords
            for (int i = 0; i < pathSegments.length; i++) {
              if (['videos', 'watch', 'reel', 'story'].contains(pathSegments[i])) {
                if (i + 1 < pathSegments.length) {
                  videoId = pathSegments[i + 1].split('?').first;
                  print('Video ID from path segments: $videoId');
                  break;
                }
              }
            }
            
            // If still null, try last segment
            if (videoId == null && pathSegments.isNotEmpty) {
              videoId = pathSegments.last.split('?').first;
              print('Video ID from last segment: $videoId');
            }
          }
        }
        
        print('Final extracted video ID: $videoId');
        
        if (videoId != null) {
          // List of URL formats to try
          final urlFormats = [
            // Native app URLs
            'fb://reel/$videoId',
            'fb://video/$videoId',
            'fb://watch/$videoId',
            // Web URLs
            'https://www.facebook.com/reel/$videoId',
            'https://www.facebook.com/watch?v=$videoId',
            'https://m.facebook.com/reel/$videoId',
          ];
          
          for (final urlFormat in urlFormats) {
            print('Attempting to launch URL: $urlFormat');
            try {
              final uri = Uri.parse(urlFormat);
              if (await canLaunchUrl(uri)) {
                print('Successfully launching URL: $urlFormat');
                await launchUrl(
                  uri,
                  mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication,
                );
                return;
              } else {
                print('canLaunchUrl returned false for: $urlFormat');
              }
            } catch (e) {
              print('Error trying to launch $urlFormat: $e');
            }
          }
        }
        
        // If we get here, try the original URL as a last resort
        print('Trying original URL as fallback: $url');
        try {
          final uri = Uri.parse(url);
          if (await canLaunchUrl(uri)) {
            print('Launching original URL');
            await launchUrl(
              uri,
              mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication,
            );
            return;
          } else {
            print('Failed to launch original URL');
          }
        } catch (e) {
          print('Error launching original URL: $e');
        }
      } else {
        // Handle other URLs
        print('Handling generic URL');
        final webUrl = Uri.parse(url);
        if (await canLaunchUrl(webUrl)) {
          await launchUrl(
            webUrl,
            mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication,
          );
          return;
        }
      }
      
      // Show error if URL couldn't be launched
      if (context.mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text('Could not open the URL')),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      print('Error launching URL: $e');
      if (context.mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text('Error opening URL: $e')),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  String _formatMetadata() {
    final List<String> items = [];
    if (reel.metadata.containsKey('likes')) {
      items.add('${reel.metadata['likes']} likes');
    }
    if (reel.metadata.containsKey('views')) {
      items.add('${reel.metadata['views']} views');
    }
    if (reel.metadata.containsKey('duration')) {
      items.add(reel.metadata['duration']);
    }
    return items.join(' • ');
  }

  Widget _buildThumbnailImage(String url) {
    // For Facebook, show a preview using the embed URL
    if (reel.platform == 'facebook') {
      print('Loading Facebook video preview with URL: $url');
      print('Metadata: ${reel.metadata}');
      
      // Get video IDs from metadata
      final finalVideoId = reel.metadata['final_video_id'];
      final regularVideoId = reel.metadata['video_id'] ?? reel.reelId;
      
      print('Final video ID: $finalVideoId');
      print('Regular video ID: $regularVideoId');
      
      // Generate embed URLs
      final embedUrls = <String>[];
      
      // Try with final video ID first
      if (finalVideoId != null && finalVideoId.isNotEmpty) {
        final watchUrl = 'https://www.facebook.com/watch?v=$finalVideoId';
        final reelUrl = 'https://www.facebook.com/reel/$finalVideoId';
        embedUrls.addAll([
          'https://www.facebook.com/plugins/video.php?href=${Uri.encodeComponent(watchUrl)}&show_text=false',
          'https://www.facebook.com/plugins/video.php?href=${Uri.encodeComponent(reelUrl)}&show_text=false',
        ]);
      }
      
      // Then try with regular video ID
      if (regularVideoId != null && regularVideoId.isNotEmpty && regularVideoId != finalVideoId) {
        final watchUrl = 'https://www.facebook.com/watch?v=$regularVideoId';
        final reelUrl = 'https://www.facebook.com/reel/$regularVideoId';
        embedUrls.addAll([
          'https://www.facebook.com/plugins/video.php?href=${Uri.encodeComponent(watchUrl)}&show_text=false',
          'https://www.facebook.com/plugins/video.php?href=${Uri.encodeComponent(reelUrl)}&show_text=false',
        ]);
      }
      
      // Add original URL as fallback
      embedUrls.add('https://www.facebook.com/plugins/video.php?href=${Uri.encodeComponent(url)}&show_text=false');
      
      print('Generated embed URLs:');
      embedUrls.forEach((url) => print('- $url'));
      
      return _FacebookVideoPreview(
        reel: reel,
        embedUrls: embedUrls,
        finalVideoId: finalVideoId ?? '',
        regularVideoId: regularVideoId ?? '',
        originalUrl: url,
      );
    }
    
    // For other platforms, use CachedNetworkImage
    return CachedNetworkImage(
      imageUrl: url,
      height: 200,
      width: double.infinity,
      fit: BoxFit.cover,
      placeholder: (context, url) => Container(
        height: 200,
        width: double.infinity,
        color: Colors.grey[200],
        child: const Center(
          child: CircularProgressIndicator(),
        ),
      ),
      errorWidget: (context, url, error) {
        print('Error loading thumbnail from URL $url: $error');
        return Container(
          height: 200,
          width: double.infinity,
          color: Colors.grey[300],
          child: Column(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              Icon(Icons.error_outline, size: 40, color: Colors.grey[600]),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Text(
                'Failed to load thumbnail',
                style: TextStyle(
                  color: Colors.grey[600],
                  fontSize: 14,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildThumbnail() {
    print('Building thumbnail for ${reel.platform} reel');
    print('Original thumbnail URL: ${reel.thumbnailUrl}');
    print('Metadata: ${reel.metadata}');

    return ClipRRect(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
      child: Stack(
        children: [
          _buildThumbnailImage(reel.thumbnailUrl),
            
          // Platform indicator
          Positioned(
            top: 8,
            right: 8,
            child: Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.7),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
              ),
              child: Row(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    reel.platform == 'facebook' ? Icons.facebook : Icons.video_library,
                    color: Colors.white,
                    size: 16,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 4),
                  Text(
                    reel.platform.toUpperCase(),
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      color: Colors.white,
                      fontSize: 12,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Builder(
      builder: (context) => GestureDetector(
        onTap: () {
          print('Card tapped for ${reel.platform} reel');
          print('URL: ${reel.url}');
          _launchURL(context, reel.url);
        },
        child: Card(
          margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
          elevation: 2,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          ),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              _buildThumbnail(),
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      reel.caption,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 16,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                      ),
                      maxLines: 2,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    Text(
                      reel.author,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 14,
                        color: Colors.grey[600],
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (reel.metadata.isNotEmpty) ...[
                      const SizedBox(height: 4),
                      Text(
                        _formatMetadata(),
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 12,
                          color: Colors.grey[600],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _FacebookVideoPreview extends StatefulWidget {
  final Reel reel;
  final List<String> embedUrls;
  final String finalVideoId;
  final String regularVideoId;
  final String originalUrl;

  const _FacebookVideoPreview({
    Key? key,
    required this.reel,
    required this.embedUrls,
    required this.finalVideoId,
    required this.regularVideoId,
    required this.originalUrl,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<_FacebookVideoPreview> createState() => _FacebookVideoPreviewState();
}

class _FacebookVideoPreviewState extends State<_FacebookVideoPreview> {
  late final WebViewController controller;
  bool isLoading = true;
  bool hasError = false;
  String? errorMessage;
  int currentUrlIndex = 0;

  Future<void> _launchVideo() async {
    try {
      String? videoId = widget.finalVideoId.isNotEmpty ? widget.finalVideoId : widget.regularVideoId;
      
      if (videoId.isNotEmpty) {
        print('Attempting to launch Facebook video with ID: $videoId');
        
        // Try different Facebook app URL formats
        final fbUrls = [
          'fb://video/$videoId',
          'fb://watch/?v=$videoId',
          'fb://story/$videoId',
          'https://m.facebook.com/story.php?story_fbid=$videoId',
          'https://m.facebook.com/watch/?v=$videoId',
          'https://www.facebook.com/watch/?v=$videoId',
        ];
        
        for (final fbUrl in fbUrls) {
          print('Trying Facebook URL: $fbUrl');
          try {
            final uri = Uri.parse(fbUrl);
            if (await canLaunchUrl(uri)) {
              print('Launching Facebook URL: $fbUrl');
              await launchUrl(uri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
              return;
            }
          } catch (e) {
            print('Error trying to launch $fbUrl: $e');
            continue;
          }
        }
      }
      
      // If video ID approach fails, try the original URL
      print('Trying original URL: ${widget.originalUrl}');
      final uri = Uri.parse(widget.originalUrl);
      if (await canLaunchUrl(uri)) {
        await launchUrl(uri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
      } else {
        throw 'Could not launch URL';
      }
    } catch (e) {
      print('Failed to launch URL: $e');
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Failed to open video: $e'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.red,
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _initializeController();
  }

  void _initializeController() {
    try {
      print('Initializing Facebook video preview with reel: ${widget.reel.toJson()}');
      
      String embedUrl;
      if (widget.embedUrls.isNotEmpty) {
        embedUrl = widget.embedUrls[currentUrlIndex];
        print('Using embed URL: $embedUrl');
      } else {
        // Fallback to constructing embed URL from reel data
        final videoId = widget.reel.metadata['final_video_id'] ?? 
                       widget.reel.metadata['video_id'] ?? 
                       widget.reel.reelId;
        print('Using video ID: $videoId');
        
        if (videoId != null && videoId.isNotEmpty) {
          final watchUrl = 'https://www.facebook.com/watch/?v=$videoId';
          final encodedWatchUrl = Uri.encodeComponent(watchUrl);
          embedUrl = 'https://www.facebook.com/plugins/video.php?href=$encodedWatchUrl&show_text=false';
        } else {
          final encodedUrl = Uri.encodeComponent(widget.reel.url);
          embedUrl = 'https://www.facebook.com/plugins/video.php?href=$encodedUrl&show_text=false';
        }
      }
      
      print('Using embed URL: $embedUrl');
      
      controller = WebViewController()
        ..setJavaScriptMode(JavaScriptMode.unrestricted)
        ..setBackgroundColor(Colors.grey[300]!)
        ..setNavigationDelegate(
          NavigationDelegate(
            onPageStarted: (String url) {
              print('WebView started loading: $url');
              if (mounted) {
                setState(() {
                  isLoading = true;
                  hasError = false;
                  errorMessage = null;
                });
              }
            },
            onPageFinished: (String url) {
              print('WebView finished loading: $url');
              if (mounted) {
                setState(() {
                  isLoading = false;
                });
              }
            },
            onWebResourceError: (WebResourceError error) {
              print('WebView error:');
              print('Error code: ${error.errorCode}');
              print('Error type: ${error.errorType}');
              print('Error description: ${error.description}');
              print('Failed URL: ${error.url}');
              
              if (mounted) {
                setState(() {
                  hasError = true;
                  isLoading = false;
                  errorMessage = 'Error loading preview (${error.errorCode})';
                });
                
                // Try next URL if available
                if (widget.embedUrls.isNotEmpty && 
                    currentUrlIndex < widget.embedUrls.length - 1) {
                  currentUrlIndex++;
                  print('Trying next embed URL: ${widget.embedUrls[currentUrlIndex]}');
                  _initializeController();
                }
              }
            },
          ),
        )
        ..setUserAgent('Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/121.0.0.0 Safari/537.36')
        ..loadRequest(Uri.parse(embedUrl));
    } catch (e, stackTrace) {
      print('Error initializing WebView controller: $e');
      print('Stack trace: $stackTrace');
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          hasError = true;
          isLoading = false;
          errorMessage = 'Failed to initialize video preview';
        });
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: _launchVideo,
      child: Container(
        height: 200,
        width: double.infinity,
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.grey[300],
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
        ),
        child: Stack(
          fit: StackFit.expand,
          children: [
            if (!hasError) ...[
              ClipRRect(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                child: WebViewWidget(controller: controller),
              ),
            ],
            if (isLoading || hasError)
              Container(
                color: Colors.grey[300],
                child: Center(
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      if (isLoading && !hasError)
                        CircularProgressIndicator(color: Colors.grey[600])
                      else if (hasError)
                        Icon(Icons.error_outline, size: 40, color: Colors.grey[600]),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      Text(
                        hasError 
                          ? 'Failed to load preview\n${errorMessage ?? ''}'
                          : 'Loading preview...',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          color: Colors.grey[600],
                          fontSize: 14,
                        ),
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            // Overlay gradient
            Positioned.fill(
              child: Container(
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  gradient: LinearGradient(
                    begin: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                    end: Alignment.topCenter,
                    colors: [
                      Colors.black.withOpacity(0.8),
                      Colors.transparent,
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            // Play button overlay
            if (!isLoading && !hasError)
              Center(
                child: Container(
                  width: 60,
                  height: 60,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.7),
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  ),
                  child: const Icon(
                    Icons.play_arrow,
                    color: Colors.white,
                    size: 40,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            // Facebook branding
            Positioned(
              bottom: 0,
              left: 0,
              right: 0,
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12, horizontal: 16),
                child: Row(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    const Icon(Icons.facebook, color: Colors.white, size: 20),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Text(
                        'Watch on Facebook',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          color: Colors.white,
                          fontSize: 14,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
